A UTF-8 string can use up to 4 bytes per codepoint. */\n112\t  MAX_FILENAME_CODEPOINTS: 32, // 32 × 4 = 128, guarantees never exceeds MAX_FILENAME_BYTES\n113\t  /** Maximum UTF-8 codepoint count for MIME type (T2). */\n114\t  MAX_MIMETYPE_CODEPOINTS: 14, // 14 × 4 = 56, fits within MAX_MIMETYPE_BYTES\n115\t} as const;\n116\t\n117\t/**\n118\t * Calculate K_manifest from blockCount and blockHashLen.\n119\t *\n120\t * K_manifest is the number of blocks needed to store the block hash manifest.\n121\t * The manifest contains blockCount × blockHashLen bytes (all block hashes),\n122\t * divided into blocks of size BLOCK (196608 bytes = K × L).\n123\t *\n124\t * Formula: K_manifest = ceil(blockCount × blockHashLen / BLOCK)\n125\t *\n126\t * @param blockCount - Number of data blocks (from beacon)\n127\t * @param blockHashLen - Length of each block hash in bytes (from beacon)\n128\t * @returns Number of blocks needed to store the manifest\n129\t */\n130\tfunction calculateKManifest(blockCount: number, blockHashLen: number): number {\n131\t  const BLOCK = 196608; // K × L where K=768, L=256 (from core/params.ts)\n132\t  const manifestBytes = blockCount * blockHashLen;\n133\t  return Math.ceil(manifestBytes / BLOCK);\n134\t}\n135\t\n136\t/**\n137\t * Parse a beacon from bytes.\n138\t *\n139\t * Beacon format: [body fields...][crc32(4)]\n140\t * The CRC-32 covers all beacon body fields and MUST be validated before\n141\t * any metadata (including streamId) is trusted.\n142\t *\n143\t * **Validation order is critical:**\n144\t * 1. Read all fields (no validation yet)\n145\t * 2. Validate CRC-32 (if this fails, ALL other values are suspect)\n146\t * 3. benchmarked maximum K (from GE benchmark)\n150\t * @param availableQuota - Available storage quota in bytes (for T1 originalSize check)\n151\t * @throws {BeaconValidationError} If any field fails validation or CRC-32 mismatch\n152\t */\n153\texport function parseBeacon(\n154\t  bytes: Uint8Array,\n155\t  localKMax: number,\n156\t  availableQuota: number\n157\t): BeaconMeta {\n158\t  let offset = 0;\n159\t\n160\t  const readU32 = () => {\n161\t    const value = (bytes[offset] << 24) |\n162\t                 (bytes[offset + 1] << 16) |\n163\t                 (bytes[offset + 2] << 8) |\n164\t                 bytes[offset + 3];\n165\t    offset += 4;\n166\t    return value >>> 0; // Force unsigned\n167\t  };\n168\t\n169\t  const readU24 = () => {\n170\t    const value = (bytes[offset] << 16) |\n171\t                 (bytes[offset + 1] << 8) |\n172\t                 bytes[offset + 2];\n173\t    offset += 3;\n174\t    return value >>> 0;\n175\t  };\n176\t\n177\t  const readU16 = () => {\n178\t    const value = (bytes[offset] << 8) | bytes[offset + 1];\n179\t    offset += 2;\n180\t    return value >>> 0;\n181\t  };\n182\t\n183\t  const readU8 = () => bytes[offset++];\n184\t\n185\t number) => {\n192\t    const len = readU8();\n193\t    if (len > maxLen) {\n194\t      throw new BeaconValidationError(\n195\t        'E-META-BOUNDS',\n196\t        `String length ${len} exceeds maximum ${maxLen}`,\n197\t        {length: len, max: maxLen}\n198\t      );\n199\t    }\n200\t    const strBytes = readBytes(len);\n201\t    // Decode as UTF-8\n202\t    const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal: true});\n203\t    try {\n204\t      return decoder.decode(strBytes);\n205\t    } catch (e) {\n206\t      throw new BeaconValidationError(\n207\t        'E-META-BOUNDS',\n208\t        'Invalid UTF-8 in string field',\n209\t        {}\n210\t      );\n211\t    }\n212\t  };\n213\t\n214\t  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ STEP 1: Read all fields (no validation yet)\n215\t\n216\t  const streamId = readU32();\n217\t  const wireVersion = readU8();\n218\t  // originalSize: 6 bytes, 48-bit (original uncompressed file size)\n219\t  const originalSize = ((readU8() << 40) & 0xff0000000000) |\n220\t                       ((readU32() << 8) & 0xffffffffff00) |\n221\t                       (readU8() & 0xff);\n222\t  // payloadLen: 6 bytes, 48-bit (actual payload length after compression)\n223\t  const payloadLen = ((readU8() << 40) & 0xff0000000000) |\n224\t                     ((readU32() << 8) & 0xffffffffff00) |\n225\t                     (readU8() & 0xff);\n226\t\n227\t  const blockSize = readU24();\n228\t  const blockCount = readU24();\n229\t  const fragmentLen = readU16();\n230\t  const degreeCap = readU8();\n231\t  const flags = readU8();\n232\t  const blockHashLen = readU8();\n233\t  const wholeFileHash = readBytes(32); // Fixed 32-byte whole file hash\n234\t  const manifestHash = readBytes(4); // Fixed 4-byte manifest hash (CRC-32)\n235\t\n236\t  // Variable fields\n237\t  const filename = readString(BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILENAME_BYTES);\n238\t  const mimeType = readString(BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_MIMETYPE_BYTES);\n239\t\n240\t  // beaconBodySize = offset;\n244\t  const expectedSize = beaconBodySize + CRC_SIZE;\n245\t\n246\t  if (bytes.length !== expectedSize) {\n247\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n248\t      'E-CRC-LENGTH',\n249\t      `Beacon size ${bytes.length} != expected ${expectedSize} (body+CRC)`,\n250\t      {actual: bytes.length, expected: expectedSize}\n251\t    );\n252\t  }\n253\t\n254\t  // Read the CRC-32 from the last 4 bytes\n255\t  const storedCrc = (bytes[offset]! << 24) |\n256\t                    (bytes[offset + 1]! << 16) |\n257\t                    (bytes[offset + 2]! << 8) |\n258\t                    bytes[offset + 3]!;\n259\t\n260\t  // Calculate CRC-32 over the beacon body (everything except the last 4 bytes)\n261\t  const calculatedCrc = crc32(bytes.subarray(0, beaconBodySize));\n262\t\n263\t  if (storedCrc !== calculatedCrc) {\n264\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n265\t      'E-CRC-MISMATCH',\n266\t      `Beacon CRC-32 mismatch: stored=${storedCrc} calculated=${calculatedCrc}`,\n267\t      {stored: storedCrc, calculated: calculatedCrc}\n268\t    );\n269\t  }\n270\t\n271\t  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ BeaconValidationError(\n276\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n277\t      `Declared original size (${originalSize}) exceeds maximum (${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE})`,\n278\t      {originalSize, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE}\n279\t    );\n280\t  }\n281\t\n282\t  // T1: originalSize must fit in available quota\n283\t  if (originalSize > availableQuota) {\n284\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n285\t      'E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT',\n286\t      `Original size (${originalSize}) exceeds available quota (${availableQuota})`,\n287\t      {originalSize, availableQuota}\n288\t    );\n289\t  }\n290\t\n291\t  // T1: payloadLen bounds check (same limit as originalSize)\n292\t  if (payloadLen > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE) {\n293\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n294\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n295\t      `Declared payload length (${payloadLen}) exceeds maximum (${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE})`,\n296\t      {payloadLen, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE}\n297\t    );\n298\t  }\n299\t\n300\t  // T1: payloadLen must fit in available quota\n301\t  if (payloadLen > availableQuota) {\n302\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n303\t      'E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT',\n304\t      `Payload length (${payloadLen}) exceeds available quota (${availableQuota})`,\n305\t      {payloadLen, availableQuota}\n306\t    );\n307\t  }\n308\t\n309\t  // Sanity: payloadLen should be ≤ originalSize (compression can only reduce)\n310\t  if (payloadLen > originalSize) {\n311\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n312\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n313\t      `Payload length (${payloadLen}) cannot exceed original size (${originalSize})`,\n314\t      {payloadLen, originalSize}\n315\t    );\n316\t  }\n317\t\n318\t  // T1: blockCount bounds check\n319\t  if (blockCount > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_BLOCK_COUNT) {\n320\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n321\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n322\t      `Block count (${blockCount}) exceeds maximum (${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_BLOCK_COUNT})`,\n323\t      {blockCount, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_BLOCK_COUNT}\n324\t    );\n325\t  }\n326\t\n327\t  // T1: K_manifest bounds check (bf-5fs)\n328\t  // K_manifest is the number of blocks needed to store the block hash manifest.\n329\t  // Unbounded K_manifest is a DoS vector: with MAX_BLOCK_COUNT (16.7M) and blockHashLen=4,\n330\t  // the manifest would be 262,144 fragments and ~8.6 GB of matrix data.\n331\t  const blockCountManifest = calculateKManifest(blockCount, blockHashLen);\n332\t  if (blockCountManifest > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_K_MANIFEST_BLOCKS) {\n333\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n334\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n335\t      `Manifest block count (${blockCountManifest}) exceeds maximum (${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_K_MANIFEST_BLOCKS}). ` +\n336\t      `This      blockCount,\n340\t        blockHashLen,\n341\t        blockCountManifest,\n342\t        max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_K_MANIFEST_BLOCKS\n343\t      }\n344\t    );\n345\t  }\n346\t\n347\t  // Sanity: blockSize should be reasonable\n348\t  if (blockSize < 1 || blockSize > 10_485_760) { // Max 10 MB per block\n349\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n350\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n351\t      `Invalid block size: ${blockSize}`,\n352\t      {blockSize}\n353\t    );\n354\t  }\n355\t\n356\t  // T1: Wire version compatibility check\n357\t  if (wireVersion !== WIRE_VERSION) {\n358\t    throw receiverVersion: WIRE_VERSION}\n362\t    );\n363\t  }\n364\t\n365\t  // T1: L must match wire constant for this version\n366\t  if (fragmentLen !== L) {\n367\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n368\t      'E-VERSION',\n369\t      `Fragment length L mismatch: sender declared ${fragmentLen}, wire constant is ${L}`,\n370\t      {senderL: fragmentLen, wireConstantL: L, wireVersion}\n371\t    );\n372\t  }\n373\t\n374\t  // T1: Secondary sanity check (should never fire if above checks pass)\n375\t  if (fragmentLen < 1 || fragmentLen > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_L) {\n376\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n377\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n378\t      `Fragment length L (${fragmentLen}) outside valid range [1, ${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_L}]`,\n379\t      {L: fragmentLen, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_L}\n380\t    );\n381\t  }\n382\t\n383\t  // Sanity: degreeCap should be within reasonable bounds (D25 says 64)\n384\t  if (degreeCap < 1 || degreeCap > 256) {\n385\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n386\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n387\t      `Invalid degree cap: ${degreeCap}`,\n388\t      {degreeCap}\n389\t    );\n390\t  }\n391\t\n392\t  // Sanity: blockHashLen should be reasonable (SHA-256 truncated to 4 bytes per plan)\n393\t  if (blockHashLen < 1 || blockHashLen > 64) {\n394\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n395\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n396\t      `Invalid block hash length: ${blockHashLen}`,\n397\t      {blockHashLen}\n398\t    );\n399\t  }\n400\t\n401\t  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ STEP 4: D26/T1: K validation\n402\t\n403\t  // Derive K from blockSize and L\n404\t  const kValidation = validateBeaconK(blockSize, fragmentLen, localKMax);\n405\t\n406\t  if (!kValidation.acceptable) {\n407\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n408\t      kValidation.error!.code,\n409\t      kValidation.error!.message,\n410\t      kValidation.error!.details\n411\t    );\n412\t  }\n413\t\n414\t  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ STEP 5: Sanity checks\n415\t\n416\t  // Sanity: blockCount × blockSize should approximately equal payloadLen\n417\t  // (last block may be short, so allow ±1 block tolerance)\n418\t  const estimatedSize = (blockCount - 1) * blockSize;\n419\t  if (payloadLen < estimatedSize - blockSize || payloadLen > blockCount * blockSize + blockSize) {\n420\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n421\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n422\t      `Inconsistent beacon: payloadLen=${payloadLen}, blockCount=${blockCount}, blockSize=${blockSize}`,\n423\t      {payloadLen, blockCount, blockSize}\n424\t    );\n425\t  }\n426\t\n427\t  return {\n428\t    streamId,\n429\t    wireVersion,\n430\t    originalSize,\n431\t    payloadLen,\n432\t    blockSize,\n433\t    blockCount,\n434\t    fragmentLen,\n435\t    degreeCap,\n436\t    flags,\n437\t    blockHashLen,\n438\t    wholeFileHash,\n439\t    manifestHash,\n440\t    filename,\n441\t    mimeType,\n442\t  };\n443\t}\n444\t\n445\t/**\n446\t * Sanitize a filename for export (T2).\n447\t *\n448\t * **Truncation rules (T2):**\n449\t * 1. Strip path separators, control bytes, and leading dots (security)\n450\t * 2. Truncate to MAX_FILENAME_CODEPOINTS (32 UTF-8 codepoints max)\n451\t * 3. If truncated, preserve filename extension when possible\n452\t * 4. Validate final UTF-8 encoding fits in MAX_FILENAME_BYTES (128 bytes)\n453\t * 5. 5) {\n479\t      // Keep extension: truncate base, preserve \".ext\"\n480\t      const ext = sanitized.substring(lastDot);\n481\t      const baseAllowed = BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILENAME_CODEPOINTS - ext.length;\n482\t      sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, baseAllowed) + ext;\n483\t    } else {\n484\t      // No extension or extension too long: simple truncate\n485\t      sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILENAME_CODEPOINTS);\n486\t    }\n487\t  }\n488\t\n489\t  // Step 5: Validate UTF-8 byte length fits in MAX_FILENAME_BYTES\n490\t  const utf8Bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(sanitized);\n491\t  if (utf8Bytes.length > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILENAME_BYTES) {\n492\t    // Byte overflow: truncate conservatively to UTF-8 safe boundary\n493\t    // Conservative: each codepoint can be up to 4 bytes, so truncate to codepoints that fit\n494\t    let byteLen = 0;\n495\t    let cpIndex = 0;\n496\t    for (let i = 0; i < sanitized.length; i++) {\n497\t      const cpBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(sanitized[i]).length;\n498\t      if (byteLen + cpBytes > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILENAME_BYTES) break;\n499\t      byteLen += cpBytes;\n500\t      cpIndex = i + 1;\n501\t    }\n502\t    sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, cpIndex);\n503\t  }\n504\t\n505\t  // Step 6: Fallback if empty after sanitization\n506\t  if (!sanitized) {\n507\t    sanitized = 'received-file';\n508\t  }\n509\t\n510\t  return sanitized;\n511\t}\n512\t\n513\t/**\n514\t * Check if resume should be disabled based on beacon flags.\n515\t *\n516\t * When compression is enabled, the sender MUST set BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled\n517\t * because non-deterministic compression makes block boundaries unstable across\n518\t * sender restarts. This prevents silent corruption of the receiver's bitmap.\n519\t *\n520\t * **How this works:**\n521\t * 1. Sender enables compression → sets both Compressed and ResumeDisabled flags\n522\t * 2. Receiver receives beacon → checks isResumeDisabled() → returns true\n523\t * 3. Receiver suppresses resume UI and does NOT persist bitmap/metadata\n524\t * 4. If interrupted, user must restart transfer from beginning (safe, no corruption)\n525\t *\n526\t * **Why this is necessary:**\n527\t * CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee. After a sender restart and\n528\t * E11 staging reaping, re-compression may produce different bytes → different\n529\t * block boundaries → different hashes → the receiver's persisted bitmap would\n530\t * become silently invalid.\n531\t *\n532\t * Solution implemented: Option B from bf-3k90 evaluation\n533\t * - Privacy (T4) preserved: no staging persistence\n534\t * - Correctness preserved: explicitly disabling unsafe resume\n535\t * - Low complexity: ~50-100 lines vs. 300-1200 for alternatives\n536\t *\n537\t * Reference: docs/notes/bf-3k90-compression-resume-solution-evaluation.md (Option B)\n538\t *            docs/notes/bf-2vke-compression-resume-t4-reap-interaction.md\n539\t *            docs/notes/bf-17s0-resume-compression-conflict.md\n540\t *\n541\t * @param flags - Beacon flags byte from received beacon\n542\t * @returns true if resume is disabled (compression enabled), false otherwise\n543\t */\n544\texport function isResumeDisabled(flags: number): boolean {\n545\t  return (flags & BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled) !== 0;\n546\t}\n547\t\n548\t/**\n549\t * Encode a beacon from constructing a BeaconMeta object to pass to this function:\n555\t * - If compression is enabled, you MUST set both flags:\n556\t *   `flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed | BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled`\n557\t * - This is required because CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee\n558\t *   across browser restarts, making resume unsafe (see below)\n559\t *\n560\t *      docs/notes/bf-2vke-compression-resume-t4-reap-interaction.md\n570\t *\n571\t * @param meta - Beacon metadata to encode\n572\t * @returns Uint8Array of encoded beacon with CRC-32\n573\t meta.wireVersion, supportedVersion: WIRE_VERSION}\n581\t    );\n582\t  }\n583\t\n584\t  if (meta.fragmentLen !== L) {\n585\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n586\t      'E-VERSION',\n587\t      `Cannot encode beacon with fragmentLen ${meta.fragmentLen}, wire constant is ${L}`,\n588\t      {requestedL: meta.fragmentLen, wireConstantL: L, wireVersion: meta.wireVersion}\n589\t    );\n590\t BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_MIMETYPE_BYTES) {\n605\t    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n606\t      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n607\t      `MIME type too long: ${mimeTypeBytes.length} bytes (max ${BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_MIMETYPE_BYTES})`,\n608\t      {length: mimeTypeBytes.length, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_MIMETYPE_BYTES}\n609\t    );\n610\t  }\n611\t\n612\t  // Fixed fields: streamId(4) + Uint8Array(totalSize);\n623\t  let offset = 0;\n624\t\n625\t  // Write fixed fields\n626\t  const writeU32 = (value: number) => {\n627\t    bytes[offset++] = (value >>> 24) & 0xff;\n628\t    bytes[offset++] = (value >>> 16) & 0xff;\n629\t    bytes[offset++] = (value >>> 8) & 0xff;\n630\t    bytes[offset++] = value & 0xff;\n631\t  };\n632\t\n633\t  const writeU24 = (value: number) => constant is ${L}`,\n      {senderL: fragmentLen, wireConstantL: L, wireVersion}\n    );\n  }\n\n  // T1: Secondary sanity check (should never fire if above checks pass)\n  if (fragmentLen < 1 ||
